description.value: Chau VeggiExpress is a vegan-only fast food restaurant in Vancouver's V6H postal area, offering plant-based quick-service meals. It is tagged in OpenStreetMap as exclusively vegan, making it a notable stop for cyclists seeking fully plant-based fuel. The business also has a catering menu listed on its OSM record.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 25m; rack (100 spaces) at 84m. Total: 100 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as a vegan-only fast food outlet (diet:vegan=only, amenity=fast_food) in Vancouver. The website URL listed in OSM (https://www.chowatchau.ca/) resolves to an entirely unrelated business — a psychic/abundance coach named Gina Silvestri — providing zero confirmatory evidence for the restaurant and indicating the domain was sold or repurposed. All amenity values are therefore derived from OSM tags alone; diet:vegan=only supports a vegan/vegetarian claim, and fast_food suggests takeout, but without website confirmation I cannot mark takeout as true. The domain mismatch is a significant concern that warrants review of whether the business is still operating at this location.
concerns: Website URL https://www.chowatchau.ca/ resolves to 'Gina Silvestri, Psychic Healer & Income Coach' — a completely unrelated business. The domain appears to have been sold or repurposed, strongly suggesting the restaurant may have closed or changed its web presence.
No street address available in OSM — only postcode V6H 3S2 is recorded.
Contact email info@chowatchau.ca uses the same domain that is now unrelated; email deliverability is uncertain.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The domain listed in OSM (chowatchau.ca) has been repurposed to a completely unrelated coaching business, suggesting the restaurant may have closed or rebranded; open/closed status cannot be confirmed from available evidence.
enrichment_extras.notes: Chau VeggiExpress (also associated with the 'Chow At Chau' brand per OSM email/website) was a known vegan fast food outlet in Vancouver. The domain repurposing warrants manual verification that the physical location is still operating before including in the directory.
